text_block_list.text: One evening, as we're walking through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with that crowd?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wow, we can win a whole bushel of carrots? That sounds like it'd make for a nice gift!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nothing wrong with trying your luck once in a while! What do we need to get a spin in?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have to get a raffle ticket first. I'll grab some things for dinner real quick!
Hishi Amazon wraps up her shopping in an instant and returns with a raffle ticket in hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's give it a go! Watch me win big!
She spins the tumbler's handle with gusto!
A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We got the grand prize?! This can't be real! What should I do, Teach?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, they're gonna flip when they hear about this!
From the sound of things, it seems like she wants to take all of her dorm residents with her to the resort, but…
choice_data_list: I think only two people can go…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hang on, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm… that changes things.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aha! I can give this to someone who deserves it for working so hard! Except everyone's been working hard recently…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: No, I can't do that! Everyone'd start fighting to go, and things would get messy real quick! Man, what now?
choice_data_list: Why don't you use it for yourself?
Why don't you use it for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Me? But I'm so busy with training…
choice_data_list: You can save it as a reward for later, then.

text_block_list.text: I tell her how she'll probably have more time once the Twinkle Series is over, so she'll have plenty of chances to use the coupon then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's a solid point. If I use it, no one'd try bickering over the coupon either!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, it's supposed to be a vacation for two, so I'll need to invite someone to go with me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I've got just the person! You should come with me, Teach! It'd be nice to go on a relaxing getaway together!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want to invite me?
Are you sure you want to invite me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? Of course I do! You're my partner in crime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here, keep this tacked up somewhere in your office so we don't forget!
And now we have one more thing to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! I did it, Teach! Man, it looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Everyone back at Miho will love thi—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wait. This single hamburger steak won't be enough for the whole dorm…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's gotta be some way I can feed 'em all…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know what to do! I'll try to memorize how it tastes so I can recreate it for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, now that that's settled, it's time for a taste test! You help too, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa… This tastes great! How'd they make it so good?!
We share the hamburger steak. It practically melts in the mouth.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nice, this is just what I wanted! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: With this many carrots, I can make carrot anything. Carrot curry, carrot stew…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hang on, now. We can even have a carrot barbecue party with all these carrots.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We can all hang out together, eating and drinking… I think that's a solid plan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll talk it over with Taiki! You should come too, Teach!
That weekend, Miho Dormitory hosts a massive barbecue party!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Dang it, I only got the third prize?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can feed everyone on one carrot alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What should I even do with this? It wouldn't feel right if I ate it all by myself…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Teach, is there anything you're cravin' tonight?
That night, the two of us have some delicious curry together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Man, not the consolation prize!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Welp, that's a raffle for you. I guess it's pretty rare to strike gold.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, time to change gears! Let's head home, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sigh…
It's a shame, but I guess luck wasn't on our side tonight.
